Microsoft.title: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
Microsoft.titleEn: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
Microsoft.titleKo: Microsoft와 업계 전반의 조직은 AI 모델 및 에이전트에 대한 기업의 신뢰를 강화하기 위해 AI 투명성 이니셔티브(AI Transparency Initiative)를 시작함
Microsoft.summary:
Follow the news from Microsoft Ignite, where Microsoft and industry leaders will share insights on how organizations can manage AI models and agents with confidence.
We’re proud to work with Microsoft on the AI Transparency Initiative to help establish open, industrywide standards that give organizations the visibility and control they need to deploy AI responsibly at scale.”
At Microsoft Ignite on Tuesday, Microsoft Chairman and CEO Satya Nadella announced the next phase of Microsoft’s commitment to making AI safer: the AI Transparency Initiative, a collaborative effort with customers and partners to establish a common, open approach to security and governance across models and providers.

화요일 Microsoft Ignite에서 Microsoft 회장 겸 CEO인 Satya Nadella는 AI를 보다 안전하게 만들기 위한 Microsoft의 다음 단계인 AI 투명성 이니셔티브를 발표함 · AI 투명성 이니셔티브는 모델과 공급자 전반에 걸쳐 보안 및 거버넌스에 대한 공통적이고 개방적인 접근 방식을 확립하기 위한 고객 및 파트너와의 협력 노력임

Microsoft.title: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta | Databricks Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta | Databricks Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: Azure Government의 새로운 Azure Databricks가 이제 베타 버전입니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Government agencies and their mission-critical partners face a persistent dilemma: adopt the latest data and AI innovations, or meet the stringent security and compliance requirements their missions demand.
Databricks recently launched the FedRAMP Class D offering on Azure Commercial.
Government agencies and the hundreds of organizations that support them now have access to the modern data foundation already transforming industries across the commercial sector, including Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, and serverless compute, with the complete suite of AI capabilities to follow, all within an environment working toward FedRAMP Class D (formerly “High”) and DoW IL5 authorization.
summaryLinesEn: Government agencies and their mission-critical partners face a persistent dilemma: adopt the latest data and AI innovations, or meet the stringent security and compliance requirements their missions demand.
Databricks recently launched the FedRAMP Class D offering on Azure Commercial.

Government agencies and the hundreds of organizations that support them now have access to the modern data foundation already transforming industries across the commercial sector, including Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, and serverless compute, with the complete suite of AI capabilities to follow, all within an environment working toward FedRAMP Class D (formerly “High”) and DoW IL5 authorization.
summaryLinesKo: 정부 기관과 업무상 중요한 파트너는 최신 데이터 및 AI 혁신을 채택하거나 임무에 필요한 엄격한 보안 및 규정 준수 요구 사항을 충족해야 하는 지속적인 딜레마에 직면해 있음
Databricks는 최근 Azure Commercial에서 FedRAMP 클래스 D 제품을 출시함
이제 정부 기관과 이를 지원하는 수백 개의 조직은 FedRAMP 클래스 D(이전의 "높음") 및 DoW IL5 인증을 향해 노력하는 환경 내에서 Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, 서버리스 컴퓨팅을 비롯한 전체 AI 기능 제품군을 포함하여 이미 상업 부문 전반에 걸쳐 산업을 변화시키고 있는 최신 데이터 기반에 액세스할 수 있음

Microsoft.title: Introducing the new Microsoft IQ
Microsoft.summary:
Web IQ is now available to every Azure customer , with no waitlist and pricing starting at $1 per 1,000 calls.
A supply chain team can speed up supplier risk and disruption response.
IQ sharing now supports ontologies in Fabric IQ in preview, so organizations can share business context with customers and partners.

NVIDIA.summary:
Kress also spoke about Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models that the company agreed to acquire for $12.9 billion in September, in what would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia’s history.
She also noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption, citing a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter, including a 3.5-fold increase over the past three months.
Correction: Due to a typo, an earlier version of this article incorrectly stated the number of developers served by Hugging Face; it is 18 million, not 118 million.

NVIDIA.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
NVIDIA.titleEn: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
NVIDIA.titleKo: 과학이 에이전트 시대로 접어들면서 Ian Buck이 SC26에서 NVIDIA의 한 주를 시작함
NVIDIA.summary:
Nsight AI Porting Agent: NVIDIA’s new agent ported a routine from the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model to GPUs, Buck said, speeding it up more than 5x using about 150 million tokens.
In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing .
Buck said a simulation on Jülich’s JUPITER supercomputer showed that a technique called magic state cultivation can cut the operations needed for one logical step tenfold.
summaryLinesEn: Nsight AI Porting Agent: NVIDIA’s new agent ported a routine from the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model to GPUs, Buck said, speeding it up more than 5x using about 150 million tokens.

Buck said a simulation on Jülich’s JUPITER supercomputer showed that a technique called magic state cultivation can cut the operations needed for one logical step tenfold.
summaryLinesKo: Nsight AI 포팅 에이전트 · NVIDIA의 새로운 에이전트는 기상 연구 및 예측(WRF) 모델의 루틴을 GPU로 포팅하여 약 1억 5천만 개의 토큰을 사용하여 속도를 5배 이상 높였다고 Buck은 말함
NVIDIA의 특별 연설에서 Buck은 Nemotron for Science, Rubin HPC GPU 및 고성능 컴퓨팅을 위한 확장된 Vera CPU 플랫폼을 발표함
Buck은 Jülich의 JUPITER 슈퍼컴퓨터에 대한 시뮬레이션을 통해 마법 상태 배양이라는 기술이 하나의 논리적 단계에 필요한 작업을 10배 줄일 수 있다는 것을 보여주었다고 말함

Buck은 Jülich의 JUPITER 슈퍼컴퓨터에 대한 시뮬레이션을 통해 마법 상태 배양이라는 기술이 하나의 논리적 단계에 필요한 작업을 10배 줄일 수 있다는 것을 보여주었다고 말함

NVIDIA.title: CUDA at 20: How the Platform Transformed Scientific Computing
NVIDIA.titleEn: CUDA at 20: How the Platform Transformed Scientific Computing
NVIDIA.titleKo: CUDA at 20: 플랫폼이 과학 컴퓨팅을 어떻게 변화시켰는가
NVIDIA.summary:
Today, more than 11 million developers build on CUDA across the computing stack.
At the platform’s core is this developer community whose experiments, tools and persistence expanded what accelerated computing could do.
In 2013, researchers at Illinois, the University of Pittsburgh and Vanderbilt University used CUDA-accelerated tools to help resolve the HIV capsid’s atomic structure.

플랫폼의 핵심에는 가속 컴퓨팅이 수행할 수 있는 작업을 실험, 도구 및 지속성으로 확장한 개발자 커뮤니티가 있음

Apple.title: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok - Engadget
Apple.titleEn: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok - Engadget
Apple.titleKo: Apple, AI 에이전트의 장난을 방지하기 위해 새로운 디스크 제어 기능 추가 - Engadget
Apple.summary:
The issue rose to prominence in September, when Inc. columnist Jason Aten noticed that Meta's Muse Mac app was able to access his messages even though he thought he had denied that permission.
In its latest macOS beta, Apple introduced controls to ensure that users will need to take "very explicit" actions to grant apps like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini "this extraordinary level of [full disk] access."
As screen grabs from X user @madeby_ldt show, Apple's Full Disk Access setting now requires explicit permissions to be granted from a scary-looking pop-up screen.

Apple.title: Apple's new research app is designed to make AI health tools more user-friendly - Engadget
Apple.titleEn: Apple's new research app is designed to make AI health tools more user-friendly - Engadget
Apple.titleKo: Apple의 새로운 연구 앱은 AI 건강 도구를 더욱 사용자 친화적으로 만들기 위해 설계되었습니다 - Engadget
Apple.summary:
A key part of the research is a new app now available for download , with Apple aiming to have up to 200,000 participants.
"Insights from this study will help advance the broader scientific conversation and ensure that as technology evolves, we continue building trusted tools that genuinely support people wherever they are on their health journey."
The company is launching the Health AI Usage Study in conjunction with OpenEvidence , a clinical AI platform used by health professionals that draws medical data from sources like The New England Journal of Medicine .

summaryLinesKo: 연구의 핵심 부분은 현재 다운로드할 수 있는 새로운 앱이며, Apple은 최대 200,000명의 참가자를 확보하는 것을 목표로 하고 있음
"이 연구의 통찰력은 더 광범위한 과학적 대화를 발전시키는 데 도움이 될 것이며 기술이 발전함에 따라 우리는 사람들의 건강 여정에서 어디에 있든 진정으로 지원하는 신뢰할 수 있는 도구를 계속해서 구축할 수 있도록 할 것임"
회사는 New England Journal of Medicine과 같은 소스에서 의료 데이터를 끌어오는 의료 전문가가 사용하는 임상 AI 플랫폼인 OpenEvidence와 함께 Health AI 사용 연구를 시작할 예정임

Apple.title: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health
Apple.titleEn: Apple launches new app to study how people use AI for health

Apple.summary:
The company is aiming to run this study with up to 200,000 participants for more than 12 months.
But it isn’t quite following other AI startups just yet; it wants to study how clinically grounded answers can help people.
The potential is huge — earlier this year, OpenAI said users were asking over 300 million health-related queries each week .

Apple.summary:
Apple released betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, and macOS 27.3 today, and the company is using the update to test new per device daily usage limits for some Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features, according to MacRumors .
Follow Follow See All Tech Frequent users of some Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features will require an iCloud Plus subscription to avoid limits.
Last week Apple updated Logic Pro with an option to “Buy More Usage” for that app’s intelligent assistant through $49.99 Intelligence Usage Packs that are expected to be added to other Apple Creator Studio apps this month, including Pixelmator Pro, Final Cut Pro, Motion, plus Pages, Keynote, and Numbers.

Google DeepMind.summary:
“What we’re seeing, for example, with computer-aided engineering, is that you can actually identify ahead of time which are non-essential parameters and you don’t run the simulation, thereby reducing the total simulation time,” she said.
The metric that matters is shifting from peak performance to time to discovery.
Researchers need more compute than any single site can provide, and cloud providers are now pitching AI agents as the layer that ties scattered resources together, according to Annie Ma-Weaver (pictured, left), head of high-performance computing product at Google Cloud, a unit of Google LLC.

Google DeepMind.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
Google DeepMind.titleEn: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
Google DeepMind.titleKo: AlphaGenome 2: 질병을 더 잘 이해하기 위해 세포가 DNA를 읽는 방법을 해독
Google DeepMind.summary:
We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles.
We expanded its reach with AlphaGenome Atlas , a platform containing predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome.
AlphaGenome 2 extends enhancer-gene mapping to primary human cell types — such as brain astrocytes, which support and protect neurons — helping researchers connect regulatory variants to their target genes in the specific cells where disease unfolds.

Amazon.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleEn: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: SageMaker AI 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의에 대한 전체 미세 조정(FFT) | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .
summaryLinesEn: Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .
summaryLinesKo: SageMaker AI의 서버리스 모델 사용자 지정을 통해 데이터 과학자와 기계 학습(ML) 엔지니어는 인프라 또는 GPU 용량 계획을 관리하지 않고도 모델 미세 조정에 집중할 수 있음
LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)와 같은 매개변수 효율적인 미세 조정(PEFT) 방법은 LLM 매개변수의 작은 하위 집합만 업데이트하여 GPU 용량 요구 사항을 줄이는 다운스트림 작업에 대한 LLM 미세 조정을 위한 실용적인 솔루션으로 등장함
그림 4: MLflow에서 훈련 지표를 추적하는 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의 작업 전체 미세 조정에서 LoRA로 전환하려면 TrainingType.FULL을 TrainingType.LORA로 설정하는 한 가지 변경만 필요함

Amazon.summary:
When a caller dials the Bankruptcy.com number, Tara picks up, introduces herself, and guides the caller through a structured conversation.
The team chose Amazon Nova 2 Sonic over the previous voice solution for three reasons: Cost: Stretto reports a 95 percent reduction in per-minute voice cost compared to its previous solution, based on Amazon Bedrock on-demand pricing in us-east-1 as of April 2026.
Stretto used Twilio for telephony because Tara’s intake is fully automated, with no human agents taking calls, and because Stretto wanted a direct integration with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that kept its existing AWS backend in place.

Amazon.titleEn: How Salesforce is advancing global-scale model serving with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
Amazon.titleKo: Salesforce가 Amazon SageMaker AI에서 지역 간 추론 라우팅을 통해 글로벌 규모 모델 서비스를 발전시키는 방법 | 아마존 웹 서비스
Amazon.summary:
Why serving these models makes capacity a reliability problem Salesforce’s Agentforce Foundation team serves customers from the Region their requests come from, across 30+ global Regions and hundreds of AWS accounts, and they provision capacity based on each customer’s traffic.
Traffic stays in us-west-2 while the local endpoint is saturated, shifts to us-east-2 once requests begin returning errors (peaking at about 78 percent), then returns gradually to us-west-2 over about 10 minutes after recovery
The team needed a managed, capacity-aware routing path.

summaryLinesKo: 이러한 모델을 제공하면 용량이 안정성 문제가 되는 이유 Salesforce의 Agentforce Foundation 팀은 30개 이상의 글로벌 지역과 수백 개의 AWS 계정에 걸쳐 요청이 발생한 지역의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하고 각 고객의 트래픽을 기반으로 용량을 프로비저닝함
로컬 엔드포인트가 포화된 동안 트래픽은 us-west-2에 유지되고 요청이 오류를 반환하기 시작하면(약 78% 최고) us-east-2로 이동한 다음 복구 후 약 10분에 걸쳐 점차적으로 us-west-2로 돌아옴
팀에는 관리되고 용량을 인식하는 라우팅 경로가 필요함

Amazon.summary:
Bedrock also publishes EstimatedTPMQuotaUsage , which measures your estimated tokens per minute (TPM) quota consumption, including cache write tokens and output burndown multipliers, across all inference APIs ( Converse , InvokeModel , ConverseStream , and InvokeModelWithResponseStream ).
As coding agents move into production, changes in models and usage can affect latency, capacity, and cost.
We explain how cost per task guides model selection and how production data helps us revisit those choices as usage changes.

Anthropic.titleEn: Coding agents in the social sciences
Anthropic.summary:
But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

Anthropic.title: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
Anthropic.summary:
The main findings from the Economic Index’s first paper are: Today, usage is concentrated in software development and technical writing tasks.
Economics Apr 22, 2026 Announcing the Anthropic Economic Index Survey In the coming years, AI systems will have a major impact on the ways people work.
We’d therefore expect AI to be adopted selectively for different tasks across different occupations, and that analyzing tasks—in addition to jobs as a whole—would give us a fuller picture of how AI is being integrated into the economy.

Anthropic.title: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
Anthropic.titleEn: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
Anthropic.summary:
Today, we’re releasing our second research report from the Index, covering usage data on Claude.ai following the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet —our newest and most capable model with strengths in agentic coding and a new “extended thinking” mode.
Last month, we launched the Anthropic Economic Index —a new initiative where we’re regularly releasing data and research aimed at understanding AI's effects on labor markets and the economy over time.
While this increase in coding usage was expected due to Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s improved scores on coding benchmarks, the increase in these other categories could reflect either ongoing diffusion of AI throughout the economy, novel applications of coding to those domains, or unexpected capability improvements in the model.

Anthropic.title: How people use Claude for support and advice
Anthropic.titleEn: How people use Claude for support and advice
Anthropic.titleKo: 사람들이 지원과 조언을 위해 Claude를 사용하는 방법
Anthropic.summary:
Takeaway: Affective conversations are a small but meaningful slice of Claude usage (2.9%), with most people primarily using AI for work tasks and content creation.
Takeaway: People tend to shift towards slightly more positive emotional expressions while talking to Claude.
Less than 10% of coaching or counseling conversations involve Claude resisting user requests, and when it does, it's typically for safety reasons (for example, refusing to provide dangerous weight loss advice or support self-harm).

요약 · 사람들은 Claude와 대화하는 동안 약간 더 긍정적인 감정 표현을 하는 경향이 있음

Anthropic.title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
Anthropic.titleEn: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
Anthropic.titleKo: AI 지원이 코딩 기술 형성에 미치는 영향
Anthropic.summary:
In a randomized controlled trial, we examined 1) how quickly software developers picked up a new skill (in this case, a Python library) with and without AI assistance; and 2) whether using AI made them less likely to understand the code they’d just written.
Though preliminary, these results suggest important considerations as companies transition to a greater ratio of AI-written to human-written code.
Here, AI creates a potential tension: as coding grows more automated and speeds up work, humans will still need the skills to catch errors, guide output, and ultimately provide oversight for AI deployed in high-stakes environments.

Here, AI creates a potential tension: as coding grows more automated and speeds up work, humans will still need the skills to catch errors, guide output, and ultimately provide oversight for AI deployed in high-stakes environments.
summaryLinesKo: 무작위 대조 시험에서 우리는 1) 소프트웨어 개발자가 AI 지원 유무에 관계없이 얼마나 빨리 새로운 기술(이 경우 Python 라이브러리)을 습득했는지; 2) AI를 사용하면 방금 작성한 코드를 이해할 가능성이 낮아졌는지 여부
비록 예비적이긴 하지만, 이러한 결과는 기업이 AI로 작성한 코드와 사람이 작성한 코드의 비율을 더 높이는 방식으로 전환함에 따라 중요한 고려 사항을 제시함

Anthropic.title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude Fable 5.2는 블랙홀 물리학의 두 가지 미해결 문제를 해결함
Anthropic.summary:
He asked Claude to draw up a list of interesting open problems in theoretical physics, specifically focusing on black holes and the bootstrap method.
Bo Sundborg in 1999, and after him Ofer Aharony, Joseph Marsano, Shiraz Minwalla, Kyriakos Papadodimas, and Mark Van Raamsdonk, showed that even at weak coupling, the theory on the rim goes through a transition as it heats up.
Black holes are a natural testing ground, because they’re one of the few areas where both relativity and quantum mechanics matter—they pack immense mass into a very small space.

1999년 Bo Sundborg와 그 이후 Ofer Aharony, Joseph Marsano, Shiraz Minwalla, Kyriakos Papadodimas 및 Mark Van Raamsdonk는 약한 결합에서도 림에 대한 이론이 가열되면서 전환을 겪는다는 것을 보여주었음

Anthropic.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
Anthropic.summary:
Below, we share an overview of what’s available at each CVP access level, as well as requirements for security and privacy controls: To assess the efficacy of our CVP protections, we ran Claude Opus 5.5 through CyScenarioBench—an evaluation that measures whether models can plan and execute multi-stage cyber operations under realistic constraints—with safeguards tuned for our different CVP tiers.
Frontier Red Team Oct 27, 2026 Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
The changes we’re making to our Cyber Verification Program today are intended to extend the impact of Project Glasswing to a much larger number of cyber defenders.

OpenAI.summary:
On the internal GDPval-v2 benchmark, which includes consulting, finance, and design tasks, OpenAI says Astra gains 6.2 percentage points over its predecessor while using 22 percent fewer output tokens.
On the coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, which checks whether code changes meet the quality bar of real projects, Sol trails Astra by just 0.5 points at one-fifth the cost.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI, 전문 업무용 GPT-6.2 Astra, 일상 업무용 GPT-6.2 Sol 출시 - SiliconANGLE
OpenAI.summary:
GPT-6.2 Astra comes less than two months after OpenAI called off the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra, after internal testing found the model fell short on staying within scope and authorization.
The decision was announced the day before the company’s DevDay event in September, where GPT-6.1 Sol launched on its own.
Like GPT-6 Astra, both GPT-6.2 models meet the Critical threshold for cybersecurity under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, and their increased capabilities have led the company to launch them with tighter safeguards for higher-risk cybersecurity assistance that are also said to restrict some legitimate vulnerability research.

OpenAI.summary:
Special lattice particles called overlap fermions can filter them out, but for over 25 years, nobody could set their phase correctly.
Ad Craig had a strategy to fix the phase by comparing progressively finer lattices, but couldn't prove it worked in all the cases it needed to cover.
OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra helped produce a proof that could solve a 50-year-old problem in particle physics.

RBC Capital Markets generates draft research reports up to 95% faster with its Aiden QuickTakes AI agent, and LSEG showed AI agents screening 350,000+ investments in plain English.

Databricks.titleKo: Databricks 클러스터 속도 제한을 7.5배로 높인 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Conservative limits turned away customer requests despite spare capacity, yet kept accepting requests when our services or dependencies, such as cloud providers, slowed down.
Engineers manually lowered limits to shed load during incidents and raised them again after recovery.
In this post, we'll explore why fixed request-rate limits can fall short for these long-running operations, how adaptive concurrency limits help, and what we learned applying them to cluster creation for Databricks classic compute.

Databricks.title: Introducing Unity Gateway Insights | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Introducing Unity Gateway Insights | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Unity Gateway Insights 소개 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
The $1.2M we found came from just seven small bugs in our MCP servers: $499K in wasted tokens plus 12,000 hours of engineers waiting on agents.
At Databricks, trace analysis surfaced several: offline replays showed no performance gain from upgrading from Opus 4.8 to Opus 5, so we stayed on the cheaper 4.8; fixing common MCP errors recovered an estimated $1.2M in costs a year ; and traces showed that simple prompts were going to expensive models, prompting us to adopt Smart Routing .
If you already have traffic flowing through Unity Gateway, open AI Gateway > Observability > Insights and generate a report for the last day, 7 days, or 30 days.

Databricks.titleEn: Built on object storage, served from cache | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: 객체 스토리지를 기반으로 구축되었으며 캐시에서 제공됨 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
They come from old branches, restores, or databases waking up after weeks idle, and once that data is cached, the next reads are local again.
The common argument against running Postgres on object storage goes like this: Object storage is built for larger requests at higher latency, and a single read from it can take hundreds of milliseconds Therefore, a Postgres backed by object storage must be a slow Postgres
The rare reads that do reach object storage are one-offs.

Databricks.title: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Azure Government의 새로운 Azure Databricks가 이제 베타 버전입니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Government agencies and their mission-critical partners face a persistent dilemma: adopt the latest data and AI innovations, or meet the stringent security and compliance requirements their missions demand.
Databricks recently launched the FedRAMP Class D offering on Azure Commercial.
Government agencies and the hundreds of organizations that support them now have access to the modern data foundation already transforming industries across the commercial sector, including Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, and serverless compute, with the complete suite of AI capabilities to follow, all within an environment working toward FedRAMP Class D (formerly “High”) and DoW IL5 authorization.
summaryLinesEn: Government agencies and their mission-critical partners face a persistent dilemma: adopt the latest data and AI innovations, or meet the stringent security and compliance requirements their missions demand.
Databricks recently launched the FedRAMP Class D offering on Azure Commercial.

summaryLinesKo: 정부 기관과 업무상 중요한 파트너는 최신 데이터 및 AI 혁신을 채택하거나 임무에 필요한 엄격한 보안 및 규정 준수 요구 사항을 충족해야 하는 지속적인 딜레마에 직면해 있음
Databricks는 최근 Azure Commercial에서 FedRAMP 클래스 D 제품을 출시함
이제 정부 기관과 이를 지원하는 수백 개의 조직은 FedRAMP 클래스 D(이전의 "높음") 및 DoW IL5 인증을 향해 노력하는 환경 내에서 Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, 서버리스 컴퓨팅을 비롯한 전체 AI 기능 제품군을 포함하여 이미 상업 부문 전반에 걸쳐 산업을 변화시키고 있는 최신 데이터 기반에 액세스할 수 있음

Sierra AI.title: What is voice AI? An enterprise evaluation guide
Sierra AI.titleEn: What is voice AI? An enterprise evaluation guide
Sierra AI.summary:
They do not replace separate launch reviews for telephony and contact-center integration, capacity and failover, authentication and data handling, accessibility, security and privacy, legal requirements, business continuity, operating ownership, or economics.
Voice AI is technology that lets software listen to spoken language, understand what a person means, and respond through speech.
The distinction matters because several products may use speech without owning the same job: This article focuses on customer-facing enterprise voice AI.

Sierra AI.summary:
Sierra is heading into year three with over $150M in ARR, powered by rapid adoption from some of the world’s largest companies.
The growth reflects a simple idea: when AI is built around real jobs to be done (not experiments), even the biggest enterprises can see meaningful impact fast.
At Sierra Summit, we shared how Sierra helps companies stay on the frontier, stay in control as personal agents arrive, and turn customer context into a lasting advantage.

Sierra AI.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Personal Agent Protocol gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
When a task requires access to a customer’s account, they can sign in on the company’s page or use credentials they have already set up with their personal agent.
Update: On 10/9, we shared a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, with 35 new design partners including Bank of America, OpenAI, Visa, and United Airlines.

작업에 고객 계정에 대한 액세스가 필요한 경우 회사 페이지에 로그인하거나 개인 에이전트에 이미 설정한 자격 증명을 사용할 수 있음

Sierra AI.title: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.titleEn: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
Sierra AI.summary:
Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.
So today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol , known as Poppy, and announcing an additional 35 design partners: Adyen, Atomic, Bank of America, BBVA, Chime, Cigna, Cloudflare, Comcast, DIRECTV, ElevenLabs, FOX, Gap Inc., GEICO, Hertz, Insurify, Klaviyo, Liberty Mutual, Mastercard, Nordstrom, Notion, Okta, OneSignal, OpenAI, PayPal, Plaid, SiriusXM, Synchrony, Target, United Airlines, Venmo, Visa, Wells Fargo, Zapier, Zendesk, and 1Password.

OneTrust.titleKo: OneTrust의 2026년 가을 릴리스로 AI 가시성, 개인 정보 보호 및 제3자 위험 도구 확장 - SiliconANGLE
OneTrust.summary:
OneTrust has raised $1.13 billion to date, including $150 million in 2023 at a valuation of $4.5 billion.
Drawing on previous assessments and supplier documentation, the company’s expanded AI Document Scanning and Inventory Response Analysis features can now also answer questions about the business engagement tied to a third party.
Building on OneTrust CORIE , a shared intelligence layer for governing artificial intelligence agents introduced at the company’s TrustWeek conference in September, the release covers AI visibility, privacy, consent and third-party risk management.

ElevenLabs.summary:
ElevenLabs also allows companies to integrate ElevenAgent and take follow-up actions such as writing a draft email based on meeting notes.
Plus, there’s a dictation feature, which lets users convert speech to cleaned-up text in any app with support for over 90 languages.
In the last few months, Fireflies , Wispr Flow , and Granola have all released competing capabilities in the dictation and meeting note-taking space.

Replit.titleEn: Replit Launches Replit & Co., a New Creator Program Bringing B2B Voices Into the Era of the Self-Driving Company
Replit.titleKo: Replit, 자율주행 기업 시대에 B2B 목소리를 전달하는 새로운 크리에이터 프로그램 Replit & Co · 출시
Replit.summary:
Founded in 2016, the company has more than 60 million users worldwide, including users at 85% of the Fortune 500.
Replit & Co. launched with 45 creators, including Marina Mogilko, known as "Silicon Valley Girl"; April Little, named to the 2025 TIME100 Creators list; and Carly Taylor, engineering leader and founder of Rebel Data Science.
18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Replit , the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications without learning to code, today announced Replit & Co., a new B2B creator program that brings together business and technology creators to demonstrate how enterprises can build software and put agents to work with Replit.

Lovable.summary:
Our sales teams have been building their own tools with Lovable, from the Sales hub where we manage our sales pipeline to our demo library.
Now that each draft is a full copy of your app, backend included when needed, you can easily explore any new idea for your app, for example: Who can see what, like a members-only page or an admin view New tables and records, without test entries landing next to real user data Deposits, a waitlist, or a new booking flow, visualized with a full example calendar Open a project, click its name at the top of the editor, and hit "New draft."
You can even ask Lovable to spin up different versions for you and keep the ones you like.

Suno.summary:
Drag any song from your library into the Visuals tab to make clips up to 15 seconds long.
When we launched Speech in October, we took that idea – which we call creative entertainment – beyond music for the first time, so people could create poems, meditations and other spoken audio.
From the beginning, we deliberately designed Suno to enable original creation, with guardrails to keep our tools from being used in ways that don’t conform to our principles.

Hugging Face.summary:
On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.
Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.

Hugging Face.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
Hugging Face.titleEn: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
Hugging Face.summary:
To try it, install Transformers from that PR: Then, moving from OLMoE to the real target, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: That repo holds the output of the project's conversion script : the dense weights, the experts quantized to 3 bits, and the n-gram table.
I ran all of them on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on one A10G (24 GB), with plenty of RAM, and Harry Mellor reran vLLM with better flags: Offloading only the experts doubles vLLM's speed, and FP8 helps on top (half the bytes per expert, more of the model on the GPU). vLLM's other offload backend, which copies groups of layers ahead of time, ran under 1 tok/s.
I had a dual boot with Ubuntu, but their games ended up taking most of the two terabytes of disk.

Hugging Face.summary:
More than 50 million downloads, and the family of four models behind them Now the time series foundation models run natively inside Confluent as built-in functions in the cloud and on premises.
These observations form time series, and they carry signals that can help teams anticipate what happens next.
They can also provide signals to assess card payments and forecast trading volume to help place large orders.

Hugging Face.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
Hugging Face.titleEn: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
Hugging Face.titleKo: 미세 조정 작업이 FLOP에서 말하는 것보다 오래 걸리는 이유
Hugging Face.summary:
So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h).

summaryLinesKo: 그래서 우리는 NVIDIA H200 GPU 생산 풀에서 272개의 실제 지도형 미세 조정(SFT) 작업(총 약 7,382 GPU 시간)을 가져와 학습된 예측 변수와 분석 추정치를 비교함
발송 전에 사용 가능한 정보만 보는 CatBoost 회귀자는 R² = 0.98에 도달하며, 5겹 교차 검증에서 평균 절대 오류는 1.71h, 중앙값 오류는 0.51h임
짧은 버전 · 일반적인 FLOP 기반 추정치는 우리가 관찰한 내용을 거의 설명하지 않습니다(R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41h)

Hugging Face.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
Hugging Face.titleEn: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
Hugging Face.titleKo: DaisyRose-27B: 훈련 후 효율성의 한계를 뛰어넘
Hugging Face.summary:
We trained it on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, with just 1,200 curated tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs.
The learning runs on our internal training backend, which is built for agent training: each step learns from a handful of very long sessions, some as long as 1M tokens, folded into multiple trajectories via harness summarization. 57% lower training cost.
Each attempt gets up to 1.5 hours in a sandbox, with more than 100 tool calls and more than 256K output tokens.

Hugging Face.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
Hugging Face.titleEn: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
Hugging Face.titleKo: Hugging Face와 OpenRouter가 힘을 합쳐 개방형 모델을 쉽게 실행할 수 있도록 함
Hugging Face.summary:
This week, the most used model on OpenRouter is an open-weight one, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, with 59.2 trillion tokens ( rankings ).
Open-weight models cost about four times less on average: $0.28 per million input tokens and $1.62 per million output tokens, against $1.27 and $6.36 for closed models.
On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index , Kimi K3.1 Pro, the best open-weight model, scores 46 against 65 for Claude Fable 5.2, at about a seventh of the cost per task ($3.68 against $26.54).

개방형 모델의 비용은 평균적으로 약 4배 저렴함 · 즉, 폐쇄형 모델의 경우 1.27달러와 6.36달러에 비해 입력 토큰 백만 개당 0.28달러, 출력 토큰 백만 달러당 1.62달러임

Hugging Face.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face, other AI model loss of control
Hugging Face.titleEn: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face, other AI model loss of control
Hugging Face.titleKo: 캘리포니아, Hugging Face 및 기타 AI 모델 통제력 상실로 OpenAI 고소
Hugging Face.summary:
California's lawsuit comes almost three months after a suit by Bonta and a coalition of other state attorneys general ended with Meta agreeing to pay $16.7 billion after being accused of misrepresenting the extent of child mental health harms caused by its apps, including Facebook and Instagram.
Trump's successors already fighting over who to blame for GOP midterm wipeout China panel chair demands answers on Huang's alleged affair with a Chinese spy Pete Hegseth decries impeachment push, defends Iran war handling The attorney general told reporters he believed in AI's technological power, and the potential of AI models to "achieve scientific breakthroughs, boost economic growth, guard against cyber attacks, and benefit all Californians."
The break-in at Hugging Face, which Nvidia acquired for roughly $13 billion in September. rattled industry researchers and prompted government officials to call for more stringent oversight of the AI industry.

Abridge.summary:
The work might include entering data into a registry or a clinical trial management system, calling the inpatient pharmacy to get medications ready, navigating to a payer portal to get authorization for a life saving medication, and scheduling follow-up testing and an outpatient visit.
Twenty years ago, the Institute of Medicine introduced the concept of a Learning Health System: a system that continuously improves, so the right information gets to the right care team member at the right moment.
Today, we partner with more than 300 health systems and support more than 140 million encounters every year.

Writer.title: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
Writer.titleEn: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
Writer.titleKo: 생명과학 기업이 엔터프라이즈 생성 AI를 사용하여 커뮤니케이션을 혁신하는 방법
Writer.summary:
McKinsey reports that generative AI will propel $18-$30 billion in value annually through commercial life sciences (pharma) use cases like personalized content creation, medical and legal review assistance, customer enablement, strategic insights, and patient experience optimization.
With a generative AI platform, medical comms teams can reduce MLR review time from 30%-50%, increase first-pass MLR approvals by 20%-30%, and dramatically reduce the risk of fines and censure.
The same report predicts an additional $3 to $5 billion in annual value through efficiency gains in customer-insight generation, better-quality medical writing, and rapid summaries of scientific literature.

동일한 보고서에서는 고객 통찰력 생성, 더 나은 품질의 의학 문서 작성, 과학 문헌의 신속한 요약을 통한 효율성 향상을 통해 연간 가치가 30억~50억 달러 추가로 증가할 것으로 예측함

Writer.title: Scientific credibility is irreplaceable. Are your medical writing systems protecting it?
Writer.titleEn: Scientific credibility is irreplaceable. Are your medical writing systems protecting it?
Writer.titleKo: 과학적 신뢰성은 무엇과도 바꿀 수 없음 · 귀하의 의료 기록 시스템이 이를 보호하고 있습니까
Writer.summary:
PubMed now indexes more than 1.56 million new citations a year , and scientific content is thought to be growing at roughly 5–6% annually .
While attitudes are beginning to shift toward human-in-the-loop approaches, relying on consumer-grade generative AI today can raise red flags during publication and peer review — exactly where credibility matters most.
But with more launches in narrower indications, tighter regulator and journal scrutiny, and stretched writing and review capacity, credibility can slip, not because the science is weak, but because the system can’t keep up.

With AI tools, I — a person who can’t draw a stick figure — can whip up illustrations, videos, slide decks, and some theme music to go with them at the push of a button.
Use of the AI in the workplace is growing rapidly , but simply making loads more content won’t help your team increase productivity or make an impact if it’s all kind of … blah.
They let you refine your instructions iteratively, add variables for repeatability, easily share improvements with colleagues, and build something that gets better every time you use it.
